hero.title: Tell <brand>Trawise</brand> where you want to stay. Let the places come to you.
hero.description: Drop a pin, set your budget and your dates. Hotels, guesthouses and hosts nearby see your request and reply with what they can offer — so you compare real answers instead of scrolling listings.
hero.scrollHint: See how it works for hotels
hero.mockupAlt: The Trawise app showing an interactive map of nearby accommodation requests alongside a hotel's details
hero.free: Free to use, and Trawise never takes a cut — you pay the place directly.

forHotels.title: How Trawise works for hotels
forHotels.subtitle: Fill your empty rooms for the closest dates by connecting directly with nearby travellers.

step1.title: Register your hotel
step1.descriptionBeforeEmail: Create a host account and enter your hotel's basic details, or email us at
step1.descriptionAfterEmail: and we'll set it up for you.

step2.title: Receive requests
step2.description: View requests from nearby travellers and choose the ones that work best for you.

step3.title: Compare and decide
step3.description: Compare price, dates and the traveller’s rating side by side, then accept, counter or decline on the row.

step4.title: Accept and welcome
step4.description: Accept your chosen request and welcome the traveller on their arrival date.

benefit1.title: Fill your last-minute vacancies
benefit1.description: Turn empty rooms into bookings for the closest dates, with no long-term commitment.

benefit2.title: Free for hotels
benefit2.description: Joining Trawise and listing your hotel costs nothing — there are no fees to get started.

benefit3.title: An extra marketing channel
benefit3.description: Reach travellers actively searching nearby, without spending on ads or promotions.

benefit2.title: Free while we grow
benefit2.description: Listing your place and answering requests is free for everyone today. Paid features will come later, and we will tell you before anything you already use starts costing money.

footer.description: Connect with nearby hosts and find budget-friendly stays on Trawise

comingSoon.title: Coming Soon to Your App Store
comingSoon.description: We're putting the finishing touches on the Trawise mobile app. Soon you'll be able to connect with nearby hosts and find budget-friendly stays right from your smartphone.

notFound.title: 404 - Page Not Found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist. Let's get you back to discovering amazing accommodation options.

cookieBanner.message: We use cookies to improve your experience. Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors use our website.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.introMessage: We're sorry to see you go. You can delete your account in two ways:

viaAppSettings.title: Via App Settings
viaAppSettings.description: Go to Settings > Delete Account to remove your data instantly.

requestHere.title: Request Here or by Email
requestHere.description: If you prefer, email us and we'll process your deletion request manually.

errorBoundary.title: Something Went Wrong
errorBoundary.description: We're sorry, but something unexpected happened. Please try refreshing the page.

faq.subtitle: How Trawise works, what it costs, and what happens after a place says yes.
